tools.name: get_presentation_overview
tools.description: Get a full overview of the PowerPoint presentation: total slide count, a text preview of each slide's shapes, AND a PNG thumbnail image of every slide. Call this FIRST before making any changes. The thumbnail images let you see the exact visual layout, design, and positioning of each slide — without them you cannot know the slide layout. Requires PowerPoint on Windows (16.0.17628+), Mac (16.85+), or PowerPoint on the web for images.

thumbnailWidth.description: Width in pixels for slide thumbnails. Default: 600.

tools.name: get_presentation_content
tools.description: Get the text content of one or more slides. Specify slideIndex for a single slide, startIndex/endIndex for a range, or omit all to read every slide.

slideIndex.description: 0-based index for reading a single slide. Omit to use range or read all.

startIndex.description: 0-based start index for a range of slides.

endIndex.description: 0-based end index (inclusive) for a range of slides.

tools.name: get_slide_image
tools.description: Capture a slide as a PNG image to see its visual design, layout, colors, and styling. Use region="full" for an overview, or "bottom-left"/"bottom-right" for 2× zoom into the bottom corners to check text overflow. Requires PowerPoint on Windows (16.0.17628+), Mac (16.85+), or PowerPoint on the web.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Aspect ratio is preserved. Default: 800.

region.description: Which part of the slide to return. "full" (default) = entire slide. "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right" = that quadrant zoomed 2×. Use bottom quadrants to inspect text overflow at the bottom of slides.

tools.name: get_slide_notes
tools.description: Get speaker notes from a PowerPoint slide. Note: The notes API has limited support in web add-ins; notes may not be available in all environments.

slideIndex.description: 0-based slide index. Omit to get notes from all slides.

tools.name: set_presentation_content
tools.description: Add a text box to a slide. Pass slideIndex equal to the current total slide count to add a new slide first.

slideIndex.description: 0-based slide index. Pass the total slide count to append a new slide before adding.

tools.name: add_slide_from_code
tools.description:
Add a richly formatted slide to the presentation using PptxGenJS code.
Provide a JavaScript function body that receives a 'slide' parameter (PptxGenJS Slide object).

PptxGenJS API reference:
- Text:   slide.addText("Hello", { x:1, y:1, w:8, h:1, fontSize:24, bold:true, color:"363636" })
- Bullets: slide.addText([{text:"Point 1",options:{bullet:true}},{text:"Point 2",options:{bullet:true}}], { x:0.5, y:1.5, w:9, h:3, fontSize:18 })
- Image (base64): slide.addImage({ data:"data:image/png;base64,...", x:1, y:1, w:4, h:3 })
- Table:  slide.addTable([["H1","H2"],["R1","R2"]], { x:0.5, y:2, w:9, fontSize:14 })
- Shape:  slide.addShape("rect", { x:1, y:1, w:3, h:1, fill:{ color:"FF0000" } })
- All positions (x, y, w, h) are in inches.

code.description: JavaScript code (function body) receiving a 'slide' parameter. Call PptxGenJS methods on it to build slide content.

replaceSlideIndex.description: Optional 0-based index of an existing slide to replace. If omitted, the new slide is appended.

tools.name: clear_slide
tools.description: Remove all shapes from a specific slide, leaving it blank.

tools.name: update_slide_shape
tools.description: Update the text content of an existing shape on a PowerPoint slide.

text.description: The new text content for the shape.

tools.name: set_slide_notes
tools.description: Add or update speaker notes for a slide. Due to API limitations, this provides guidance rather than directly modifying notes in all environments.

tools.name: duplicate_slide
tools.description: Duplicate an existing slide by copying its text content into a new slide. Note: Only text shapes are copied; complex graphics may not be preserved.

sourceIndex.description: 0-based index of the slide to duplicate.

tools.name: get_selected_slides
tools.description: Get the currently selected slide(s). Call this first to know which slide the user is working on.

tools.name: get_slide_shapes
tools.description: List all shapes on a slide with their index, name, type, position (inches), size (inches), and text. Use this before modifying, moving, or deleting individual shapes.

tools.name: get_slide_layouts
tools.description: List all available slide layouts from the first slide master. Use before apply_slide_layout.

tools.name: delete_slide
tools.description: Delete a slide from the presentation by its 0-based index.

slideIndex.description: 0-based index of the slide to delete.

tools.name: move_slide
tools.description: Reorder a slide by moving it to a new position. Requires PowerPoint 16.0.14326+ (requirement set 1.8).

fromIndex.description: 0-based index of the slide to move.

toIndex.description: 0-based destination index the slide should occupy after the move.

tools.name: delete_shape
tools.description: Delete a specific shape from a slide by its index. Use get_slide_shapes first.

tools.name: set_shape_text
tools.description: Set the text content of a shape by name (preferred) or by index. Use get_slide_shapes first to identify names and indices.

text.description: New text content for the shape.

shapeName.description: Name of the shape to update (preferred over shapeIndex).

shapeIndex.description: 0-based shape index. Used when shapeName is not provided.

tools.name: move_resize_shape
tools.description: Move and/or resize a shape on a slide. All values are in inches (matching add_slide_from_code). Omit any property to leave it unchanged.

left.description: New left position in inches from the left edge of the slide.

top.description: New top position in inches from the top edge of the slide.

tools.name: update_shape_style
tools.description: Update the visual style of a shape: fill color, font color, font size, bold. Use get_slide_shapes to get the shapeIndex first.

fillColor.description: 6-digit hex fill color without # (e.g. "4472C4"). Use "none" to remove fill.

tools.name: set_slide_background
tools.description: Set the solid background color of a slide.

color.description: 6-digit hex color without # (e.g. "1F2937" for dark charcoal). Use "none" to reset to theme default.

tools.name: apply_slide_layout
tools.description: Apply a slide layout to a slide by name or index. Use get_slide_layouts to see available layouts first.

layoutName.description: Name of the layout to apply (from get_slide_layouts). Preferred.

layoutIndex.description: 0-based layout index. Used when layoutName is not provided.

tools.name: add_geometric_shape
tools.description: Add a geometric shape to a slide. Position and size are in inches, consistent with add_slide_from_code.

shapeType.description: Shape type — e.g. "rectangle", "roundedRectangle", "ellipse", "triangle", "rightTriangle", "diamond", "pentagon", "hexagon", "star5", "heart", "cloud", "arrowRight", "arrowLeft". See PowerPoint.GeometricShapeType for full list.

tools.name: add_line
tools.description: Add a straight line (connector) to a slide. Coordinates are in inches, consistent with add_slide_from_code.

tools.name: group_shapes
tools.description: Group multiple shapes on a slide into a single group shape. Use get_slide_shapes first to identify the shape indices. Requires PowerPoint 16.0.17531+ (requirement set 1.8).

shapeIndices.description: Array of 0-based shape indices (from get_slide_shapes) to group together. Must contain at least 2 indices.

groupName.description: Optional name for the resulting group shape.

tools.name: ungroup_shapes
tools.description: Ungroup a grouped shape on a slide, releasing its child shapes back to the slide. Use get_slide_shapes first to identify the group shape index (type will be "Group"). Requires PowerPoint 16.0.17531+ (requirement set 1.8).

shapeIndex.description: 0-based index of the group shape to ungroup (from get_slide_shapes, type should be "Group").

tools.name: get_smartart_info
tools.description: List all SmartArt and diagram shapes on a slide with their index, name, position, and size. Use this to inspect existing SmartArt graphics. Note: SmartArt content cannot be modified via the Office.js API — use add_slide_from_code with PptxGenJS to create SmartArt-like visuals programmatically.

tools.name: get_theme_colors
tools.description: Read the presentation theme color palette from the first slide master. Returns the named theme colors (e.g., dk1, dk2, lt1, lt2, accent1–accent6, hlink, folHlink) so you can use brand-consistent colors instead of hardcoded hex values. Call this early when creating slides to match the presentation style.

tools.name: get_presentation_properties
tools.description: Read presentation document properties: title, subject, author, keywords, and category.

tools.name: set_presentation_properties
tools.description: Set presentation document properties. Only provided fields are updated; others are left unchanged.

tools.name: get_selected_text_range
tools.description: Read the currently selected text in PowerPoint. Use this when the user says "rephrase this", "translate this", "make this shorter", or refers to selected content. Returns the selected text and the slide index where the selection is.

tools.name: set_shape_alt_text
tools.description: Set the alternative text (alt text) on a shape for accessibility. Use this for images, charts, and decorative shapes so screen readers can describe them.

altText.description: Descriptive alt text for the shape. For decorative shapes, use empty string.

tools.name: get_hyperlinks
tools.description: List all hyperlinks on a slide. Returns the shape name/index, linked text, and URL for each hyperlink.

tools.name: add_hyperlink
tools.description: Add a hyperlink to an existing shape on a slide. The entire shape becomes clickable.

tools.name: fetch_image_as_base64
tools.description: Fetch an image from a URL and return it as a base64 data URI. Use the returned data URI with add_slide_from_code's slide.addImage({data: "..."}) to place the image on a slide.

url.description: The image URL to fetch (must be HTTPS).

tools.name: get_table_data
tools.description: Read all cell values from a table shape on a slide. Use get_slide_shapes first to find table shape indices (shapes with type "Table").

shapeIndex.description: 0-based shape index of the table (from get_slide_shapes).

tools.name: set_table_cell
tools.description: Update the text in a specific cell of a table shape. Use get_table_data first to see current values.
